observations: Photo 0: Two large blue plastic drums with black lids, one in front of the other. The drums show signs of wear, dirt, and scratches. A white label is visible on the side of the front drum.
Photo 1: Same two drums from a slightly different angle. The white label is still visible. The drums appear to be stacked or placed side by side. The front drum has a small metal cap on its lid.

Photo 2: Two blue drums stacked vertically. The top drum has a white label with 'STRENE DRUM 001' and other text. The label is partially obscured by dirt and wear. The drums appear to be made of thermoplastic.

Photo 3: Two blue drums stacked vertically. The label on the top drum clearly reads 'STRENE DRUM 001'. The label also shows a barcode and serial number. The drums show significant wear, including scratches, dirt, and possible cracks near the seams.
All photos show a watermark 'NENI INVESTMENT' and 'POSTED ON JIJI'.

No visual evidence of ice block storage. The drums are not shown with ice or any related contents. The claim cannot be verified from the photos.
No visual evidence of water storage. The drums are not shown with water or any related contents. The claim cannot be verified from the photos.
No visual evidence of drinks. The drums are not shown with beverages or any related contents. The claim cannot be verified from the photos.
